The structure of Mg2V4(Se2O10)2, or Mg2V4Se4O20, crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2/c (No. 15), with a 32-atom unit cell and six independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows V centers in octahedral environments coordinated by six O atoms, while Mg centers adopt octahedral coordination with two O and four Se neighbors; Se centers show five geometric neighbors. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner-sharing between Mg and V octahedra, and edge-sharing between Mg and V octahedra, forming a three-dimensional periodic connectivity.
